+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Select conservative PR lanes using only a verified protected-base checkout.
+
+Cargo edges are not a complete file-input graph. The audited snapshot additionally
+binds all non-server workspace package trees and root build/dependency inputs.
+Changed consumer code (including new cross-package includes) disables the server
+optimization until a reviewed update adopts that input contract.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+AUDITED_INPUT_SHA256 = "9f7aff4dc25c9c6561b77ea73342b675eeccb1d008ab9d1fbdbd504618ec5ab8"
+AUDITED_DOC_INPUT_SHA256 = "b983e36bc734fafd55dcad16fb0a335d73a490338b30e10a999f4899bde5da43"
+SERVER = "oteryn-game-server"
+WINDOWS = {"oteryn-client", "oteryn-synthetic-client-harness", "oteryn-simulation-determinism"}
+REQUIRED = {
+    SERVER: "apps/game-server",
+    "oteryn-client": "apps/client",
+    "oteryn-synthetic-client-harness": "tools/synthetic-client-harness",
+    "oteryn-simulation-determinism": "crates/simulation-determinism",
+}
+BUILD_INPUTS = {"Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock", "rust-toolchain.toml", "rustfmt.toml", "deny.toml", "workspace-boundaries.toml", ".gitattributes", ".gitmodules"}
+
+
+def full(reason: str, surface: str = "unknown") -> dict:
+    return dict(rust=True, windows=True, surface=surface, reason=reason)
+
+
+def valid_path(value) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, str) and bool(value) and not any(c in value for c in "\x00\n\r\\") and not value.startswith("/") and ".." not in value.split("/") and str(PurePosixPath(value)) == value
+
+
+def neutral(path: str) -> bool:
+    if PurePosixPath(path).name in {"AGENTS.md", "AGENTS.override.md"} or path.startswith("docs/migration/"):
+        return False
+    return path in {"README.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md"} or (path.startswith("docs/") and path.endswith(".md"))
+
+
+def graph(metadata: dict):
+    workspace = PurePosixPath(metadata["workspace_root"])
+    if not workspace.is_absolute():
+        raise ValueError("relative workspace")
+    packages = metadata["packages"]
+    members = metadata["workspace_members"]
+    if not isinstance(packages, list) or not isinstance(members, list) or not packages or len(set(members)) != len(members):
+        raise ValueError("invalid workspace")
+    roots, ids = {}, set()
+    for package in packages:
+        name, ident = package["name"], package["id"]
+        manifest = PurePosixPath(package["manifest_path"])
+        root = str(manifest.parent.relative_to(workspace))
+        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or name in roots or ident in ids or manifest.name != "Cargo.toml" or not valid_path(root) or root == ".":
+            raise ValueError("ambiguous package")
+        roots[name] = root
+        ids.add(ident)
+    if ids != set(members) or any(roots.get(name) != root for name, root in REQUIRED.items()):
+        raise ValueError("unresolved workspace roots")
+    if len(set(roots.values())) != len(roots) or any(a != b and a.startswith(b + "/") for a in roots.values() for b in roots.values()):
+        raise ValueError("overlapping package roots")
+    by_path = {str(workspace / path): name for name, path in roots.items()}
+    reverse = {name: set() for name in roots}
+    for package in packages:
+        dependencies = package["dependencies"]
+        if not isinstance(dependencies, list):
+            raise ValueError("invalid dependencies")
+        for dependency in dependencies:
+            if not isinstance(dependency.get("name"), str) or dependency.get("kind") not in {None, "dev", "build"}:
+                raise ValueError("unknown dependency")
+            path = dependency.get("path")
+            if path is not None:
+                if path not in by_path:
+                    raise ValueError("unresolved local dependency")
+                # Deliberately union optional, dev/build and every target condition.
+                reverse[by_path[path]].add(package["name"])
+    return roots, reverse
+
+
+def input_digest(metadata: dict, include_server: bool = False) -> str:
+    roots, _ = graph(metadata)
+    prefixes = tuple(path + "/" for name, path in roots.items() if include_server or name != SERVER)
+    records = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "HEAD"]).split(b"\0")
+    selected = []
+    for record in records:
+        if not record:
+            continue
+        info, raw_path = record.split(b"\t", 1)
+        if info.split()[0] not in {b"100644", b"100755"}:
+            raise ValueError("unmodelled symlink/submodule input")
+        path = raw_path.decode("utf-8")
+        if path in BUILD_INPUTS or path.startswith(".cargo/") or path.startswith(prefixes):
+            selected.append(record)
+    return hashlib.sha256(b"\0".join(sorted(selected)) + b"\0").hexdigest()
+
+
+def classify(files, changed_count, metadata, digest, complete=True, docs_digest=None) -> dict:
+    try:
+        if complete is not True or type(changed_count) is not int or not isinstance(files, list) or len(files) != changed_count or not files:
+            return full("incomplete-enumeration")
+        paths, filenames = [], set()
+        for item in files:
+            path = item["filename"]
+            status = item.get("status")
+            previous = item.get("previous_filename")
+            if not valid_path(path) or path in filenames or status not in {"added", "modified", "removed", "renamed", "copied", "changed", "unchanged"}:
+                return full("invalid-file-record")
+            filenames.add(path)
+            paths.append(path)
+            if status == "renamed" and not previous:
+                return full("missing-rename-source")
+            if previous is not None:
+                if not valid_path(previous):
+                    return full("invalid-rename-source")
+                if neutral(path) != neutral(previous):
+                    return full("cross-surface-rename")
+                paths.append(previous)
+        if all(neutral(path) for path in paths):
+            graph(metadata)
+            if digest != AUDITED_INPUT_SHA256 or docs_digest != AUDITED_DOC_INPUT_SHA256:
+                return full("unreviewed-document-consumer-inputs", "docs")
+            return dict(rust=False, windows=False, surface="docs", reason="neutral-documentation")
+        if any(path.startswith(".cargo/") or PurePosixPath(path).name in BUILD_INPUTS | {"build.rs"} for path in paths):
+            return full("explicit-build-or-dependency-input", "dependencies-build")
+        if any(path.startswith((".github/", "tools/repository/", "tools/agents/", "docs/migration/")) or PurePosixPath(path).name in {"AGENTS.md", "AGENTS.override.md"} for path in paths):
+            return full("explicit-build-or-control-input", "control-plane")
+        roots, reverse = graph(metadata)
+        affected = set()
+        for path in paths:
+            if neutral(path):
+                continue
+            owners = [name for name, root in roots.items() if path.startswith(root + "/")]
+            if len(owners) != 1 or PurePosixPath(path).suffix not in {".rs", ".sql"}:
+                return full("unmodelled-input")
+            affected.add(owners[0])
+        pending = list(affected)
+        while pending:
+            for consumer in reverse[pending.pop()] - affected:
+                affected.add(consumer)
+                pending.append(consumer)
+        if affected & WINDOWS:
+            surface = "simulation" if "oteryn-simulation-determinism" in affected else "shared" if SERVER in affected else "client"
+            return full("windows-consumer-affected", surface)
+        if SERVER not in affected or affected != {SERVER}:
+            return full("mixed-or-unowned-surface")
+        if digest != AUDITED_INPUT_SHA256:
+            return full("unreviewed-consumer-input-snapshot")
+        surface = "durability" if any(any(token in path for token in ("/durability/", "/migrations/", "postgres", "reconnect")) for path in paths) else "server"
+        return dict(rust=True, windows=False, surface=surface, reason="server-only-reverse-closure-and-audited-inputs")
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):
+        return full("classifier-input-failure")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    try:
+        metadata = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        digest = input_digest(metadata)
+        result = classify(json.loads(os.environ["CHANGED_FILE_RECORDS"]), int(os.environ["CHANGED_FILE_COUNT"]), metadata, digest,
+                          complete=os.environ["ENUMERATION_COMPLETE"] == "true", docs_digest=input_digest(metadata, include_server=True))
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, AttributeError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
+        result = full("classifier-or-metadata-failure")
+    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
+    with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write(f"rust={str(result['rust']).lower()}\nwindows={str(result['windows']).lower()}\n")
+    return 0
+
+

name: Agent governance

run-name: >-
  Agent governance • ${{ github.event_name }} •
  ${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pull_request_number || github.ref_name }}

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize
      - edited
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request_number:
        description: 'Open PR number, e.g. 58 (a pasted "pull_request_number: 58" is also accepted)'
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_head_sha:
        description: 'Exact 40-character PR head SHA (a pasted "expected_head_sha: ..." is also accepted)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: agent-governance-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.inputs.pull_request_number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Agent governance / validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      TARGET_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Verify pull request target and metadata
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          DISPATCH_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.pull_request_number }}
          DISPATCH_EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.inputs.expected_head_sha }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import sys
          import urllib.error
          import urllib.request

          event_name = os.environ["EVENT_NAME"]
          repository = os.environ["REPOSITORY"]
          errors: list[str] = []

          def normalize_labeled_input(raw: str, label: str) -> str:
              value = raw.strip()
              prefix = f"{label}:"
              if value.lower().startswith(prefix.lower()):
                  value = value[len(prefix):].strip()
              return value

          if event_name == "workflow_dispatch":
              number_text = normalize_labeled_input(
                  os.environ.get("DISPATCH_PR_NUMBER", ""),
                  "pull_request_number",
              )
              expected_head = normalize_labeled_input(
                  os.environ.get("DISPATCH_EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA", ""),
                  "expected_head_sha",
              ).lower()
              event_sha = os.environ.get("EVENT_SHA", "").strip().lower()

              if re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", number_text) is None:
                  errors.append("pull_request_number must be a positive integer")
              if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", expected_head) is None:
                  errors.append("expected_head_sha must be a full lowercase 40-character SHA")
              if expected_head != event_sha:
                  errors.append(
                      "workflow dispatch ref does not resolve to expected_head_sha; "
                      "select the exact PR head branch before running"
                  )
          else:
              number_text = os.environ.get("EVENT_PR_NUMBER", "").strip()
              expected_head = os.environ.get("EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA", "").strip().lower()

              if re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", number_text) is None:
                  errors.append("pull request event is missing a valid PR number")
              if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", expected_head) is None:
                  errors.append("pull request event head SHA is invalid")

          if errors:
              for error in errors:
                  print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)

          request = urllib.request.Request(
              f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/pulls/{number_text}",
              headers={
                  "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
                  "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['GH_TOKEN']}",
                  "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
              },
          )
          try:
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  pull = json.load(response)
          except (urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
              print(f"unable to read pull request metadata: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1) from exc

          title = pull.get("title", "")
          body = pull.get("body") or ""
          head_sha = pull.get("head", {}).get("sha", "").lower()
          head_repository = pull.get("head", {}).get("repo", {}).get("full_name", "")
          base_ref = pull.get("base", {}).get("ref", "")
          state = pull.get("state", "")

          if state != "open":
              errors.append("governance validation requires an open pull request")
          if head_sha != expected_head:
              errors.append(
                  "pull request head moved after the triggering event or dispatch SHA was recorded"
              )
          if head_repository != repository:
              errors.append("governance validation only accepts same-repository pull request heads")
          if base_ref != "main":
              errors.append("governance validation only accepts pull requests targeting main")
          if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", head_sha) is None:
              errors.append("live pull request head SHA is invalid")

          pattern = re.compile(
              r"^(feat|fix|docs|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)"
              r"(\([a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*\))?!?: [A-Za-z0-9].+$"
          )
          if len(title) > 72:
              errors.append("PR title must be at most 72 characters")
          if not pattern.fullmatch(title):
              errors.append("PR title must follow type(scope): imperative summary")
          for heading in ("## Summary", "## Scope", "## Validation"):
              if heading not in body:
                  errors.append(f"PR body is missing {heading}")

          if errors:
              for error in errors:
                  print(f"- {error}", file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)

          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as env_file:
              env_file.write(f"TARGET_SHA={head_sha}\n")

          print(f"Validated live PR metadata and exact target head {head_sha}.")
          PY

      - name: Check out exact target
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TARGET_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify checked-out SHA
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ env.TARGET_SHA }}
        run: |
          actual_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "$actual_sha" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
          echo "Validated exact checkout: $actual_sha"

      - name: Validate agent governance
        run: python tools/agents/validate_governance.py

      - name: Test legacy Remote Desktop prompt routing
        run: python tools/agents/test_validate_remote_desktop_prompt_routing.py

      - name: Test lean prompt deduplication
        run: python tools/agents/test_prompt_deduplication.py

      - name: Test Codex Remote Desktop regressions
        run: python tools/agents/test_validate_remote_desktop_prompt_routing_codex_regressions.py

      - name: Test Codex round-12 regressions
        run: python tools/agents/test_validate_remote_desktop_prompt_routing_codex_round12.py

      - name: Validate inherited prompt policy
        run: python tools/agents/validate_inherited_prompt_policy.py

      - name: Validate repository policy
        run: python tools/repository/validate_repository_policy.py

run-name: Architecture semantic audit • pull_request • ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize
      - ready_for_review

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: architecture-semantic-audit-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  audit:
    name: Architecture semantic audit / validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Resolve live exact pull request head
        id: resolve
        env:
          EVENT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import urllib.request

          number = os.environ['EVENT_PR_NUMBER'].strip()
          event_head = os.environ['EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA'].strip().lower()
          if re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', number) is None:
              raise SystemExit('invalid pull request number')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', event_head) is None:
              raise SystemExit('invalid event head SHA')

          request = urllib.request.Request(
              f"https://api.github.com/repos/{os.environ['REPOSITORY']}/pulls/{number}",
              headers={
                  'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
                  'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['GH_TOKEN']}",
                  'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2026-03-10',
                  'User-Agent': 'Oteryn-v2-architecture-semantic-audit',
              },
          )
          with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
              pull = json.load(response)

          live_head = pull.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower()
          base_sha = pull.get('base', {}).get('sha', '').lower()
          if pull.get('state') != 'open':
              raise SystemExit('audit requires an open pull request')
          if pull.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name') != os.environ['REPOSITORY']:
              raise SystemExit('audit accepts only same-repository PR heads')
          if pull.get('base', {}).get('ref') != 'main':
              raise SystemExit('audit accepts only PRs targeting main')
          if live_head != event_head:
              raise SystemExit(f'pull request head moved: event={event_head} live={live_head}')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', base_sha) is None:
              raise SystemExit('invalid base SHA')

          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as out:
              out.write(f'head_sha={live_head}\n')
              out.write(f'base_sha={base_sha}\n')
          print(f'Independent semantic audit target: PR #{number} exact head {live_head}, base {base_sha}')
          PY

      - name: Check out exact head
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.head_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact checkout
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"

      - name: Run deterministic independent semantic audit
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.head_sha }}
        run: |
          python tools/architecture/semantic_contract_audit.py \
            --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
            --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA"

name: Merge authority audit

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize
      - edited

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: merge-authority-audit-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  audit:
    name: Merge authority audit / protected-base validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    env:
      EXPECTED_MERGE_GROUP_GATE_BLOB: "e3291fe8fca8fcf70166d5652b43d5a26fa0d762"
    steps:
      - name: Validate control-plane candidate as inert data
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import base64
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import urllib.parse
          import urllib.request

          repository = os.environ['REPOSITORY']
          number = os.environ['EVENT_PR_NUMBER'].strip()
          expected_head = os.environ['EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA'].strip().lower()
          expected_gate_blob = os.environ['EXPECTED_MERGE_GROUP_GATE_BLOB'].strip().lower()

          if re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', number) is None:
              raise SystemExit('invalid pull request number')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', expected_head) is None:
              raise SystemExit('invalid pull request head SHA')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', expected_gate_blob) is None:
              raise SystemExit('protected-base merge-group gate blob pin is invalid')

          headers = {
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['GH_TOKEN']}",
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
              'User-Agent': 'Oteryn-protected-base-merge-authority-audit',
          }

          def api(path: str):
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}{path}',
                  headers=headers,
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  return json.load(response)

          pull = api(f'/pulls/{number}')
          live_head = pull.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower()
          if pull.get('state') != 'open':
              raise SystemExit('audit requires an open pull request')
          if live_head != expected_head:
              raise SystemExit('pull request head moved after event identity was recorded')
          if pull.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name') != repository:
              raise SystemExit('audit accepts only same-repository pull request heads')
          if pull.get('base', {}).get('ref') != 'main':
              raise SystemExit('audit accepts only pull requests targeting main')

          changed_files = pull.get('changed_files')
          if not isinstance(changed_files, int) or changed_files < 0 or changed_files > 3000:
              raise SystemExit('invalid or over-cap changed-files count')

          changed = []
          page = 1
          while True:
              batch = api(f'/pulls/{number}/files?per_page=100&page={page}')
              for item in batch:
                  changed.append(item.get('filename', ''))
                  previous = item.get('previous_filename')
                  if isinstance(previous, str) and previous:
                      changed.append(previous)
              if len(batch) < 100:
                  break
              page += 1
          if len([path for path in changed if path]) < changed_files:
              raise SystemExit('changed-files enumeration is incomplete')

          touches_control_plane = any(
              path == '.github/repository-policy.json'
              or path.startswith('.github/workflows/')
              or path.startswith('tools/repository/')
              for path in changed
          )
          if not touches_control_plane:
              print('No merge-authority control-plane paths changed; protected-base audit not applicable.')
              raise SystemExit(0)

          if '.github/workflows/merge-authority-audit.yml' in changed:
              raise SystemExit(
                  'candidate modifies the protected-base audit itself; require explicit owner-authorized '
                  'audit rotation and independent deep review before integration'
              )

          encoded_path = urllib.parse.quote('.github/workflows/merge-group-gate.yml', safe='/')
          payload = api(f'/contents/{encoded_path}?ref={expected_head}')
          if payload.get('encoding') != 'base64' or not isinstance(payload.get('content'), str):
              raise SystemExit('unable to read candidate merge-group gate as inert content')
          gate = base64.b64decode(payload['content']).decode('utf-8')
          gate_bytes = gate.encode('utf-8')
          actual_blob = hashlib.sha1(
              f'blob {len(gate_bytes)}\0'.encode('ascii') + gate_bytes
          ).hexdigest()
          if actual_blob != expected_gate_blob:
              raise SystemExit(
                  'candidate merge-group gate does not match the protected-base approved blob: '
                  f'expected {expected_gate_blob}, got {actual_blob}'
              )

          merge_group_head_expression = '$' + '{{ github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}'
          durability_result_expression = '$' + '{{ needs.durability_postgres.result }}'
          required = (
              '  merge_group:\n    types: [checks_requested]\n',
              '    name: game-gate\n',
              '    if: always()\n',
              '    needs: [candidate, dependency_review, codeql, rust_linux, durability_postgres, rust_windows, rust_supply_chain]\n',
              '    name: Merge Queue / Durability PostgreSQL harness\n',
              '        image: postgres:17.6-bookworm@sha256:f3bd19c606e442c3d7bdfa8002e03fe260a1023351e0ea4598032022b68dd6e3\n',
              f'          EXPECTED_SHA: {merge_group_head_expression}\n',
              '          cargo +1.94.0 test --locked -p oteryn-game-server --test durability_postgres\n',
              '    name: Merge Queue / Rust Windows client\n',
              '        run: cargo +1.94.0 test --locked -p oteryn-simulation-determinism --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\n',
              f'          DURABILITY_POSTGRES: {durability_result_expression}\n',
              '            test "$result" = success\n',
          )
          for fragment in required:
              if fragment not in gate:
                  raise SystemExit(f'candidate merge-group gate missing protected fragment: {fragment.strip()}')
          for forbidden in (
              'continue-on-error:',
              'workflow_dispatch:',
              'pull_request_target:',
              'contents: write',
              'actions: write',
              'checks: write',
              'pull-requests: write',
              'statuses: write',
              'id-token: write',
          ):
              if forbidden in gate:
                  raise SystemExit(f'candidate merge-group gate contains forbidden behavior: {forbidden}')

          uses_line = re.compile(r'^\s*uses:\s*([^@\s]+)@([^\s#]+)', re.MULTILINE)
          for action, ref in uses_line.findall(gate):
              if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', ref) is None:
                  raise SystemExit(f'candidate merge-group gate uses unpinned action {action}@{ref}')

          print(
              f'Protected-base merge-authority audit PASS for PR #{number} exact head '
              f'{expected_head}; merge-group gate blob={actual_blob}.'
          )
          PY

name: Merge gate

run-name: Merge gate • pull_request • ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize
      - edited

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: merge-gate-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  scope:
    name: Merge gate / scope
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      pr_number: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.pr_number }}
      target_sha: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.target_sha }}
      base_sha: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.base_sha }}
      file_records: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.file_records }}
      file_count: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.file_count }}
      complete: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.complete }}
    steps:
      - name: Resolve and validate exact pull request head
        id: detect
        env:
          EVENT_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import sys
          import urllib.request

          repository = os.environ['REPOSITORY']
          number_text = os.environ.get('EVENT_PR_NUMBER', '').strip()
          expected_head = os.environ.get('EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA', '').strip().lower()
          errors: list[str] = []

          if re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', number_text) is None:
              errors.append('pull request number must be a positive integer')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', expected_head) is None:
              errors.append('pull request head SHA must be a full lowercase 40-character SHA')

          if errors:
              for error in errors:
                  print(f'- {error}', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)

          headers = {
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['GH_TOKEN']}",
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
              'User-Agent': 'Oteryn-v2-merge-gate',
          }

          request = urllib.request.Request(
              f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/pulls/{number_text}',
              headers=headers,
          )
          with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
              pull = json.load(response)

          state = pull.get('state', '')
          head_sha = pull.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower()
          head_repository = pull.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name', '')
          base_ref = pull.get('base', {}).get('ref', '')
          base_sha = pull.get('base', {}).get('sha', '').lower()
          changed_files = pull.get('changed_files')

          if state != 'open':
              errors.append('merge-gate validation requires an open pull request')
          if head_sha != expected_head:
              errors.append('pull request head moved after event head was resolved')
          if head_repository != repository:
              errors.append('merge gate only accepts same-repository pull request heads')
          if base_ref != 'main':
              errors.append('merge gate only accepts pull requests targeting main')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', base_sha) is None:
              errors.append('pull request base SHA is invalid')
          if not isinstance(changed_files, int) or changed_files < 0:
              errors.append('pull request changed_files count is invalid')
          complete = type(changed_files) is int and 0 <= changed_files <= 300
          files: list[str] = []
          batch = []
          if not errors and complete:
              # SHA-bound comparison prevents mutable PR-files ABA substitution.
              files_request = urllib.request.Request(
                  f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/compare/{base_sha}...{expected_head}?per_page=1',
                  headers=headers,
              )
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(files_request, timeout=30) as response:
                      comparison = json.load(response)
                  batch = comparison.get('files')
                  if not isinstance(batch, list):
                      complete = False
                      batch = []
                  for item in batch:
                      if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get('filename'), str):
                          complete = False
                          break
                      files.append(item['filename'])
              except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
                  complete = False
          if len(files) != changed_files:
              complete = False

          if not errors:
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  pull_after_files = json.load(response)
              if pull_after_files.get('state') != 'open':
                  errors.append('pull request closed during scope classification')
              if pull_after_files.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != expected_head:
                  errors.append('pull request head moved during scope classification')
              if pull_after_files.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name') != repository:
                  errors.append('pull request repository changed during scope classification')
              if pull_after_files.get('base', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != base_sha:
                  errors.append('pull request base moved during scope classification')
              if pull_after_files.get('base', {}).get('ref') != 'main':
                  errors.append('pull request base ref changed during scope classification')
              if pull_after_files.get('changed_files') != changed_files:
                  errors.append('pull request file count changed during scope classification')

          if errors:
              for error in errors:
                  print(f'- {error}', file=sys.stderr)
              raise SystemExit(1)

          records = [
              {key: item[key] for key in ('filename', 'status', 'previous_filename') if key in item}
              for item in batch
          ] if complete else []
          serialized = json.dumps(records, separators=(',', ':'))
          if len(serialized.encode('utf-8')) > 32768:
              complete = False
              serialized = '[]'
          print(f'Validated PR #{number_text} exact head {head_sha} against base {base_sha}.')
          print(f'Changed files: {changed_files}; complete immutable enumeration: {complete}')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
              output.write(f'pr_number={number_text}\n')
              output.write(f'target_sha={head_sha}\n')
              output.write(f'base_sha={base_sha}\n')
              output.write(f'file_count={changed_files}\n')
              output.write(f'file_records={serialized}\n')
              output.write(f"complete={'true' if complete else 'false'}\n")
          PY

  lanes:
    name: Merge gate / trusted-base risk lanes
    needs: scope
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:

          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.target_sha }}

      - name: Classify Durability PostgreSQL target
        id: pg_target
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.target_sha }}
          EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.base_sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PULL_NUMBER: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.pr_number }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import re
          import sys
          import urllib.request

          repository = os.environ['REPOSITORY']
          number_text = os.environ['PULL_NUMBER'].strip()
          expected_head = os.environ['EXPECTED_HEAD'].strip().lower()
          expected_base = os.environ['EXPECTED_BASE'].strip().lower()
          target = 'apps/game-server/tests/durability_postgres.rs'

          if re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', number_text) is None:
              raise SystemExit('pull request number must be a positive integer')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', expected_head) is None:
              raise SystemExit('expected pull request head SHA is invalid')
          if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', expected_base) is None:
              raise SystemExit('expected pull request base SHA is invalid')

          headers = {
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['GH_TOKEN']}",
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
              'User-Agent': 'Oteryn-v2-postgres-target-classifier',
          }

          def api(path: str):
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}{path}',
                  headers=headers,
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                  return json.load(response)

          pull = api(f'/pulls/{number_text}')
          if pull.get('state') != 'open':
              raise SystemExit('PostgreSQL target classification requires an open pull request')
          if pull.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != expected_head:
              raise SystemExit('pull request head moved after exact target resolution')
          if pull.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name') != repository:
              raise SystemExit('PostgreSQL target classification accepts only same-repository heads')
          if pull.get('base', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != expected_base:
              raise SystemExit('pull request base moved after exact target resolution')

          changed_files = pull.get('changed_files')
          if not isinstance(changed_files, int) or changed_files < 0 or changed_files > 300:
              raise SystemExit('invalid or over-cap changed-files count')

          files: list[str] = []
          removed = False
          comparison = api(f'/compare/{expected_base}...{expected_head}?per_page=1')
          batch = comparison.get('files')
          if not isinstance(batch, list):
              raise SystemExit('immutable comparison omitted its files; fail closed')
          for item in batch:
              filename = item.get('filename', '')
              if filename:
                  files.append(filename)
              previous_filename = item.get('previous_filename')
              status = item.get('status')
              if (filename == target and status == 'removed') or (
                  previous_filename == target and filename != target
              ):

          if len(files) != changed_files:
              raise SystemExit(
                  f'changed-files enumeration mismatch: API reports {changed_files}, '
                  f'collected {len(files)}; fail closed'
              )

          pull_after_files = api(f'/pulls/{number_text}')
          if pull_after_files.get('state') != 'open':
              raise SystemExit('pull request closed during Durability PostgreSQL target classification')
          if pull_after_files.get('head', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != expected_head:
              raise SystemExit('pull request head moved during Durability PostgreSQL target classification')
          if pull_after_files.get('head', {}).get('repo', {}).get('full_name') != repository:
              raise SystemExit('pull request repository changed during Durability PostgreSQL target classification')
          if pull_after_files.get('base', {}).get('sha', '').lower() != expected_base:
              raise SystemExit('pull request base moved during Durability PostgreSQL target classification')
          if pull_after_files.get('changed_files') != changed_files:
              raise SystemExit('pull request changed-files count moved during Durability PostgreSQL target classification')

          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
              output.write(f"removed={'true' if removed else 'false'}\n")
          print(f'Durability PostgreSQL target removal/rename in exact PR diff: {removed}.')
          PY

      - name: Strict Clippy

    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on:
      group: game-runners
      labels: oteryn-game
    env:
      EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME: oteryn-synology-game
      EXPECTED_RUNNER_UID: "1001"
      EXPECTED_ORG_URL: https://github.com/Oteryn
      CANARY_HOST: 192.168.1.2
      CANARY_LOGIN_PORT: "7171"
      CANARY_GAME_PORT: "7172"
    steps:
      - name: Verify exact Game runner identity and least privilege
        env:
          ACTUAL_RUNNER_NAME: ${{ runner.name }}
          ACTUAL_RUNNER_OS: ${{ runner.os }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$ACTUAL_RUNNER_NAME" = "$EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME"
          test "$ACTUAL_RUNNER_OS" = "Linux"
          test "$(id -u)" = "$EXPECTED_RUNNER_UID"
          test "$(id -g)" = "$EXPECTED_RUNNER_UID"
          test -d /runner
          test -d /work
          test -w /runner
          test -w /work
          test ! -e /var/run/docker.sock
          if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo 'Game runner unexpectedly has working Docker-host control' >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Verify persistent organization registration identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          state="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < /runner/.runner)"
          case "$state" in
            *'"agentName":"oteryn-synology-game"'*) ;;
            *) echo 'unexpected persistent runner agentName' >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          case "$state" in
            *'"gitHubUrl":"https://github.com/Oteryn"'*) ;;
            *) echo 'unexpected persistent runner organization URL' >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          case "$state" in
            *'"workFolder":"/work"'*|*'"workFolder":"_work"'*) ;;
            *) echo 'unexpected persistent runner workFolder' >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac

      - name: Verify existing local Canary integration reachability
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for port in "$CANARY_LOGIN_PORT" "$CANARY_GAME_PORT"; do
            timeout 5 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$CANARY_HOST/$port; exec 3>&-; exec 3<&-"
          done

      - name: Record sanitized acceptance evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo 'GAME_RUNNER_ACCEPTANCE=PASS'
            echo "RUNNER_NAME=${{ runner.name }}"
            echo 'RUNNER_ROUTE=game-runners/oteryn-game'
            echo 'RUNNER_SCOPE=organization'
            echo 'RUNNER_UID_GID=1001:1001'
            echo 'DOCKER_HOST_CONTROL=ABSENT'
            echo 'CANARY_LOGIN_REACHABILITY=PASS'
            echo 'CANARY_GAME_REACHABILITY=PASS'

  contents: read

jobs:
  worldmap-reconstruction:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0

          python-version: '3.12'
